source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-12 by column extension at fixed N: the start is CA(121; 2, 109, 7), the PCA product of Bose orthogonal arrays built by the R package CAs 0.24.4 (CAs:::labelToCode("pcaCA", 2, 109, 7)), plus five new columns of random symbols (programs/start_121x114.txt); simulated annealing over the whole array at 121 rows (programs/casa.c, the project's tools/own_arrays/casa.c: casa 121 2 114 7 1 600 0.5 0.99995 out programs/start_121x114.txt) reached zero holes after 40 s. Exact check with ca_verify, all column pairs.
construction: Column extension at fixed N by simulated annealing, starting from the PCA product of Bose orthogonal arrays at 109 columns
notes: size equals the cited best known value (PCAx2PCA, Colbourn tables); first array the table can give for it
